How I handled the definitions and data:
- **Segments:** the raw values mix case and have stray spaces (`' consumer'`, `'Enterprise '`, `'SMB'` and so on). After trimming and lowercasing they collapse into three groups.
- **KST dates:** converting times to KST matters here. 81 paid orders fall into a different quarter depending on whether you use UTC or KST.
- **Data checks:** none of these turned up a problem:
  - Every refund is on a paid order and matches an existing order line.
  - No line has more refunded than ordered.
  - No line has duplicate refund records.
  - No order points to a missing customer or product.
  - There are no missing values.
